Anand Mohan: aanand mohan jel jane se pahle pure bihar men railiyan karne ki taiyari men hain... is ranniti ko lekar samarthakon ke sath baithak aur manthan ka daur jari hai... kya hai aanand mohan ka pura plan aur in railiyon ke pichhe ki ranniti, dekhie yah riport sirph Bihar Tak par.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
